options.label: The Collaborative Dispatch Board
options.thesis: A live decision console where Pollito acts as tactical dispatcher and every poll is a live-updating gauge.
options.viewport: A split-hero dispatch station with an interactive working Slack poll that visitors can click to test immediately.
options.risk: Requires impeccable tactile physics so the interactive poll doesn't feel like a toy.

raised.raise: The voting tally and quorum meters carry immediate live telemetry discipline.

options.label: Modernist Vector Studio
options.lineage: Linear dark-mode precision meets Duolingo character warmth
options.thesis: Surgical software craft where Pollito is a crisp monoline SVG character reacting to team decisions.
options.viewport: Hero with Pollito hatching from egg upon scroll, live voting telemetry badge, direct Add to Slack CTA.
options.risk: Also the direction most high-craft SaaS runs in this category land on.

options.label: Midnight Phosphor Terminal
options.case: Fuses poorly: business teams in Slack do not want their poll bot to feel like a mainframe debugging terminal.
options.kept: Live telemetry discipline and unambiguous status readouts.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Generic white SaaS page with blue button, stock card grid, and an illustration of people pointing at a whiteboard.
canonCard.viewport: Standard centered headline, subhead, blue button, 3 feature cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Simple Poll or Polly.
